Position title: SAP iXp Intern - CX OMS Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Engineer Location: Montreal, Canada Expected start date to end date: April 2026 - November 2026 (8 months) • Collaborate with developers, QA, and infrastructure teams to diagnose build issues, deployment failures, and environment discrepancies. • Create, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for efficient builds, tests, and deployments. • Write and maintain automation scripts to streamline processes and reduce manual tasks. • Build dashboards to collect and analyze operational metrics of applications. • Research and prototype new tools or methods to enhance developer experience and improve delivery speed. • Document runbooks, deployment steps, and operational procedures for knowledge sharing. Where you Belong Be part of SAP Next Gen, a global community for students, universities, schools and educational partners, who are passionate about innovation and technology. 1. Open doors for future career opportunities within SAP and beyond. Our Order Management team based in Montreal within the SAP Customer Experience (CX) organization is dedicated to delivering outstanding customer experiences through a unified and seamless approach. We are currently focused on further enhancing our best-in-class cloud-native solution. As an intern on our team, you will have the exciting opportunity to dive into innovative projects as you help transform the landscape of our order management solution, making it more reliable, high-performing, scalable, and secure. You'll thrive here if you're someone who loves to solve complex problems, think creatively, and learn continuously. You'll work alongside passionate engineers and designers who value both technical excellence and user empathy. Every project is an opportunity to grow your skills, test new technologies, and contribute to solutions that have a real, global impact. What makes this team special? The combination of cutting-edge technology and strong mentorship. You'll be part of a group that encourages you to explore, ask questions, and take ownership of your ideas - while supporting you every step of the way. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning. • Recently graduated or pursuing (in final year) a master's or bachelor's degree in software engineering or computer science. • Basic knowledge of cloud technologies, microservice architecture, and Java programming. • Familiarity with Git and basic CI/CD concepts (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions). • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash and Groovy. • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization tools like Docker is a plus. • Knowledge of Cloud Foundry and Kubernetes is advantageous. • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies and best practices. • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
